fields.label: Job Type
fields.note: Board facet Remote_Job/Job_Type; the public endpoint rejects extra query params with HTTP 400, so filtering is client-side.

fields.label: Industry
fields.note: Board facet Industry (the board publishes no department field).

notes: auxo.ai itself is unreachable from this network (connect timeout); the user-confirmed board is auxoAI's own Zoho Recruit career site at auxoai.zohorecruit.com/jobs/Careers. GET /recruit/v2/public/Job_Openings?pagename=Careers&source=CareerSite returned all 55 rows in one response with info.facets = Remote_Job, Job_Type, Industry, City, Country (no pagination). Adding facet parameters (e.g. &Job_Type=Full time&Country=India) returns HTTP 400 INTERNAL_ERROR, so the rendered board applies every facet in the browser: all filtering is local.
